## History

Mr. Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as the community's new minister, having brought his bride to the village five years prior. During a visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), he and his wife attended a tea party where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served a layer cake flavored with anodyne liniment. Following the sudden death of [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Mr. Allan and his wife offered support to the grieving household, with Mrs. Allan comforting [Anne](../character/anne.md) through her grief. Over the course of his time in the parish, Mr. Allan served the local congregation while his wife maintained warm relationships with community members like [Anne](../character/anne.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

Allan and [Anne](../character/anne.md) share a warm, friendly bond built on mutual affection and understanding. Their relationship began when Allan and her husband moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where [Anne](../character/anne.md) quickly formed a fond attachment to her as the new minister's wife. Even after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served Allan a cake flavored with liniment, Allan reacted with kindness and comfort, inviting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to show her the flower garden rather than holding the mistake against her.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>
